response.sql: WITH per_site AS (SELECT s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat, AVG(p.memusagegb) AS avg_mem, AVG(CAST(p.procgpu AS REAL) / NULLIF(p.proccpu, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM scanprocessing p JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = p.zoneref WHERE p.memusagegb > 60.8 GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat) SELECT entrystat, AVG(avg_mem) AS avg_of_avg_memusagegb, AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_of_avg_gpu_cpu_ratio FROM per_site GROUP BY entrystat

assumptions.assumption: 'Memory-heavy' means memusagegb strictly greater than 60.8 (cutoff itself excluded).

Runs with proccpu = 0 are treated as missing ratio (NULLIF) to avoid division by zero; NULL ratios are ignored by AVG. Ratio is computed per run, then averaged per site, then averaged per access status.
Groups are keyed by site code and entrystat (one entrystat per site), via an inner join to sites so unmatched zonerefs are excluded.

alternatives.interpretation: Memory-heavy means memusagegb at or above 60.8 (cutoff inclusive).
